goal: Establish a ratcheted source-bound baseline, then compile user requirements into traceable executable obligations before comparing direct Agent and composed DAG execution.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 0 separates Kernel, Application, and Experiment receipt freshness and promotes BASELINE-OBLIGATION-001 only after fast regression passes
obligations, dependency policies, error semantics, and traceability are immutable, deterministic, source-bound, and complete before generation
hidden acceptance cannot introduce an untraceable project requirement
direct Agent and composed DAG routes use independent workspaces and the same obligation and acceptance facts
no prior protected guarantee is removed or silently weakened

quality_metrics.measure: promoted baselines with passing targeted and fast regression
quality_metrics.method: validate every promotion receipt against the baseline ledger and fast regression receipt
compare compiled obligation ids with public and hidden acceptance mappings
run three independently generated CLI cases under the fixed Provider matrix

quality_metrics.measure: removed guarantees, accepted interface breaks, whole replans, manual edits
quality_metrics.method: inspect baseline receipts, interface diffs, repair traces, and candidate workspace hashes

prevention: Freeze Kernel behavior and define measurable acceptance before each bounded phase
assurance: Run source-bound receipt freshness, ledger validation, and targeted contract tests
control: Run the fast baseline before promoting each new baseline
improvement: Record ratchet failures and feed only evidence-backed changes into the next phase

interface_expectations: Kernel, Application, and Experiment receipts use separate source boundaries
obligations preserve deterministic source traceability across direct and DAG routes

worked: Phase 0 separated source boundaries and promoted only after targeted, full Kernel, and fast baseline evidence passed.
Phase 1 added source-bound obligation, dependency-policy, completeness, and traceability contracts while the ratchet caught and repaired both stale receipts.
Phase 2 compiled the full CSV public contract, removed an unauthorized malformed-CSV hidden assertion, and achieved complete hidden obligation traceability.
experiments: Promote one bounded baseline after every logical layer instead of deferring regression to the end.
